problem:
Let $A=[\begin{aligned}7 & 14 \\ -2 & k\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3\end{aligned}],$ where $k$ is a constant such that $k\ne -4.$ Which of the following statements are true?

- $det(A)=0$
- The system  $Ax=0$ has exactly one solution
- The lines $7x+14y=2$ and $-2x+ky=-3$ intersect at infinitely many points
